'''Blue 35''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Blue 35 was assigned to the [[Ringali Shell]], working alongside [[Green 4]]. They advised Alliance forces that the [[Ringali Shell Security Force]] were stepping up [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] investigations.<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
